shortDescription: Trace wellhead equipment from delivery to installation and return. Link schematics, follow equipment timelines and audit logs, and export styled Excel records in a multilingual Windows workspace.
features: Track orders, Inventory and installed equipment with retained/permanent transfers, unavailable stock states and auditable PN/SN matching.
Return, inspect, repair, test and release equipment through controlled lifecycle actions; preserve Quarantine and disposal history.
Use reviewed source-label references to correct linked schematic PNs, retain prior revisions and review updated drawings.
Use global Undo/Redo, named revisions and current worksheet selections; export wrapped PN/SN cells, standard Notes and editable history charts.
Search by SN, follow a full-width location timeline and open the exact full-log record; print the selected graph or log subtab.
Continue working during background save, backup, sync and export. Remember export destinations and formats, see measured saving progress and return to MIE on completion.
Set minimum-stock policies, highlight shortages and review Autofill suggestions from historical wells and rig schedules.
Plan rig/well activities, equipment requirements and dated procurement using available stock and incoming orders.
Explore equipment and procurement Metrics; export selected licensed planning worksheets to Excel.
Synchronize through Google Drive or supported WebDAV services, with optional project/backup encryption.
20-language guides and synthetic tutorials, light/dark/custom themes and configurable graphs, highlights and tips.
